    //==
    // # SphericalCap
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_cap

    // The cap's height along the axis: R * (1 - cos theta). Runs from 0 (empty) to
    // 2R (the whole ball, at theta = pi).
    CapHeight(c: SphericalCap): Number
        => c.Sphere.Radius * (1.0 - c.PolarAngle.Cos);
